commands.name: GetAddOnVersion
commands.description: Retrieves the version of the Tapir Additional JSON Commands Add-On.

version.description: Version number in the form of "1.1.1".

commands.name: GetArchicadLocation
commands.description: Retrieves the location of the currently running Archicad executable.

archicadLocation.description: The location of the Archicad executable in the filesystem.

commands.name: GetArchicadReleaseInfo
commands.description: Retrieves the main version, release version and build number of the running Archicad, with the caption of its window.

mainVersion.description: The main version of the running Archicad, e.g. 29.

releaseVersion.description: The release (update) version of the running Archicad.

buildNumber.description: The build number of the running Archicad.

caption.description: The caption of the Archicad application window. Missing when Archicad does not report it.

commands.name: GetPrinterInfo
commands.description: Retrieves Archicad's current print settings: the print area, grid, fixed text size and scale (the settings PrintView takes).

printArea.description: The area Archicad prints, as set in the print settings. 'unknown' for a value this add-on does not name.

fixText.description: Whether text is printed in fixed size.

commands.name: QuitArchicad
commands.description: Performs a quit operation on the currently running Archicad instance.

commands.name: GetPointFromUser
commands.description: Asks the designer to click a point in the current window and returns it. Archicad waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then; the call fails when the input is cancelled.

prompt.description: Shown in the control box while Archicad waits for the click. Single-byte text: the box takes a char field. Archicad's main thread waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then.

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates.

commands.name: GetElementFromUser
commands.description: Asks the designer to click an element in the current window and returns its id, its type and the clicked point. A click on empty space or on an element of a type not asked for asks again. Archicad waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then; cancelling returns cancelled.

prompt.description: Shown in the control box while Archicad waits for the click. Single-byte text: the box takes a char field. Archicad's main thread waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then.

elementTypes.description: Only an element of one of these types is accepted. A click on empty space or on an element of another type asks for the click again. Default: any element.

elementId.description: The clicked element. In a section or elevation window it is the model element the section element was cut from.

elementType.description: The type of the clicked element (one of the ElementType values, or Unknown).

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates, as GetPointFromUser returns it.

elementPosition.description: The coordinate of the clicked part of the element (e.g. its node or hotspot), when Archicad gives one for it.

cancelled.description: True when the input was cancelled with Escape; no other field is returned then.

commands.name: GetCurrentWindowType
commands.description: Returns the type of the current (active) window.

commands.name: GetCurrentWindowDrawingScale
commands.description: Returns the drawing scale of the current (active) window, the scale shown in the bottom bar, as its denominator: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20. Unlike GetViewSettings it needs no saved view. It reads the scale of the current database: the floor plan, a section, elevation, interior elevation, detail, worksheet or 3D document window, each of which has its own. Layouts always return 1.0.

scale.description: The denominator of the drawing scale of the current window: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20. Always 1.0 for layouts.

commands.name: SetCurrentWindowDrawingScale
commands.description: Changes the drawing scale of the current (active) window, the scale shown in the bottom bar, to the given denominator: 100 for 1:100. It changes the scale of the current database: the floor plan, a section, elevation, interior elevation, detail, worksheet or 3D document window, each of which has its own. Layouts are always 1:1 and are rejected. The scale must be between 1 and 30000. The change is undoable.

scale.description: The denominator of the new drawing scale: 100 for 1:100, 20 for 1:20. Archicad accepts scales between 1 and 30000.

rebuild.description: Rebuild the window after the scale changed (the API's zoom flag). Default: false.

commands.name: ChangeWindow
commands.description: Changes the current (active) window to the given window. A databaseId on its own is enough; the window type is taken from the database. With windowType 'FloorPlan' and a storyIndex it also activates that story on the floor plan.

commands.name: GetContainingDatabases
commands.description: Returns the database (window type, database id and name) that contains each of the given elements, from any database, not only the current one. Pass the windowType and databaseId to ChangeWindow to open it, for example to find an element placed on a layout.

databases.description: The database of each element, in the order of the input elements. Pass windowType and databaseId to ChangeWindow to open it.

name.description: The name of the database (for example the name of the layout). Empty for databases without a name, like the floor plan.

commands.name: GetUserGSID
commands.description: Get the current registered User-GSID and OrganizationsID. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

userId.description: The stable GSID User ID of the logged-in user.

organizationIds.description: The list of organization IDs the user belongs to. Empty if not part of any organization or if the information cannot be retrieved.

commands.name: ShowAlert
commands.description: Display a dialog with up to three buttons.

alertType.description: The type of the alert dialog.

title.description: The title of the alert dialog.

subMessage.description: Optional smaller sub-message text below the main message.

button2.description: Label for the second button (e.g. Cancel).

button3.description: Label for the optional third button.

clickedButton.description: Index of the button the user clicked: 1 = button1, 2 = button2, 3 = button3.

commands.name: GetSpecialFolders
commands.description: Retrieves the filesystem paths of the special folders of the running Archicad (preferences, cache, data, temporary, application, defaults, templates, help, embedded project library, etc.).

folderTypes.description: The types of the special folders to retrieve.

commands.name: GetProductVersionInfo
commands.description: Retrieves the version information of the running Archicad: build number, language code, product family and version text, plus the product name, product type and main/update/hotfix versions from Archicad 29. Requires Archicad 28 or later.

productName.description: The name of the product. Archicad 29 or later.

productType.description: The Graphisoft product type. Archicad 29 or later.

productFamilyId.description: The identifier of the product family.

languageCode.description: The Graphisoft language code of the running Archicad (for example INT, GER).

buildNumber.description: The build number of the running Archicad.

versionString.description: The full version of the running Archicad as text.

mainVersion.description: The main version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

updateVersion.description: The update version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

hotfixVersion.description: The hotfix version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

versionNumbers.description: The three parts of the version number. Archicad 28 only.

commands.name: Get3DCutawayStatus
commands.description: Returns whether 3D Cutaway is on and whether the cutting planes are shown in the 3D window. In Archicad 25-27 the 3D window may need to be open.

cutawayEnabled.description: Whether 3D Cutaway is on in the 3D window.

cuttingPlanesVisible.description: Whether the cutting planes are shown in the 3D window.

commands.name: Set3DCutawayStatus
commands.description: Turns 3D Cutaway on or off and shows or hides the cutting planes in the 3D window. In Archicad 25-27 the 3D window may need to be open.

cutawayEnabled.description: Turns 3D Cutaway on or off. Left unchanged when omitted.

cuttingPlanesVisible.description: Shows or hides the cutting planes. Left unchanged when omitted.

commands.name: SetDialogAutoClose
commands.description: Turns the dialog auto close on or off. While it is on, Archicad closes the dialogs it would show with their default button instead of waiting for the user, so automation is not blocked by them. To have it on already while Archicad opens a project (before any command can be sent), set the TAPIR_DIALOG_AUTOCLOSE environment variable to true for the Archicad process before starting it.

enabled.description: True turns the dialog auto close on: Archicad closes the dialogs it would show with their default button instead of waiting for the user. False turns it off.

commands.name: GetProjectInfo
commands.description: Retrieves information about the currently loaded project.

isUntitled.description: True, if the project is not saved yet.

isTeamwork.description: True, if the project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project.

projectLocation.description: The location of the project in the filesystem or a BIMcloud project reference.

projectPath.description: The path of the project. A filesystem path or a BIMcloud server relative path.

commands.name: GetProjectInfoFields
commands.description: Retrieves the names and values of all project info fields.

commands.name: SetProjectInfoField
commands.description: Sets the value of a project info field.

projectInfoId.description: The id of the project info field.

projectInfoValue.description: The new value of the project info field. An empty string clears the field.

commands.name: CreateProjectInfoFields
commands.description: Creates one or more custom project info fields.

projectInfoFields.description: Array of custom project info fields to create.

commands.name: DeleteProjectInfoFields
commands.description: Deletes one or more custom project info fields. Hardcoded fields cannot be deleted.

projectInfoIds.description: List of project info field ids to delete. Only custom fields (ids starting with 'autotext-') can be deleted.

commands.name: GetStories
commands.description: Retrieves information about the story structure of the currently loaded project: index, floor id, name, level, height and, from Archicad 28, the IFC GlobalId of each story.

skipNullFloor.description: Floor indices above ground-floor level may start with 1 instead of 0.

commands.name: SetStories
commands.description: Sets the story sructure of the currently loaded project.

commands.name: GetAutoTextKeys
commands.description: Retrieves the available autotext keys (name and embeddable key), optionally for a specific element. Embed a key in a Text or Label content by surrounding it with '<' and '>'.

elementId.description: Optional. The element to retrieve context dependent autotext keys for (its own properties, plus the ones common to all element types, e.g. 'Element ID', 'Area'). When omitted, only the autotext keys common to all element types are returned.

name.description: The autotext's name, as shown in the Insert Autotext dialog of Archicad.

key.description: The autotext's key. To embed it in the content of a Text or Label element, surround it with '<' and '>', e.g. '<PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548>'.

commands.name: GetAutoTextName
commands.description: Retrieves the display names of one or more autotext keys (as returned inside a '<...>' embedded key), with a direct guid lookup for property-based keys instead of enumerating every property definition.

keys.description: Autotext keys as returned by GetAutoTextKeys or GetProjectInfoFields (without the surrounding '<' and '>'), e.g. 'PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548' or 'PROJECTNAME'.

commands.name: GetNoteAutoTextKeywords
commands.description: Retrieves the keywords of note autotexts (the autotexts of dimension, label and other element notes) by their numeric API_NoteAutotextID values. Available from Archicad 26.

autoTextIds.description: Numeric values of the API_NoteAutotextID enumeration of the Archicad API (the autotexts of dimension, label and other element notes).

keywords.description: One result per input id, in the same order.

keyword.description: The keyword of the note autotext.

commands.name: GetHotlinks
commands.description: Gets the file system locations (path) of the hotlink modules and the instance elements placed from each node. The hotlinks can have tree hierarchy in the project.

commands.name: CreateHotlinkNodes
commands.description: Creates hotlink module nodes from source files. A node that already points at the same file is returned instead of duplicated (Archicad 26 and later; 25 cannot see an unplaced node).

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink module nodes to create. A node that already points at the same source file (compared case-insensitively) is returned as it is, with existing: true, and the name and story settings asked for are ignored. On Archicad 25 a node that has not been placed yet cannot be found, so a repeated request there creates a second node.

sourceLocation.description: Absolute path of the module source file (.mod or .pln).

name.description: Optional display name of the node. Defaults to the file name. Ignored when a node for the same file already exists.

storyRangeType.description: Optional. Which stories of the source are placed: all of them, or the single reference story. Ignored when a node for the same file already exists.

refFloorIndex.description: Optional index of the reference story in the source file. Defaults to 0. Ignored when a node for the same file already exists.

hotlinkNodes.description: One item per requested node, in order: the node guid with its existing flag, or an error.

commands.name: CreateHotlinkInstances
commands.description: Places instances of hotlink module nodes at an origin, rotation and mirroring.

commands.name: ChangeHotlinkInstances
commands.description: Moves, rotates or mirrors placed hotlink instances by changing their transformation. MoveElements and RotateElements do not work on hotlink instances.

hotlinkInstances.description: The placed hotlink instances to change. Every field but elementId is optional; a field that is omitted keeps its current value.

commands.name: UpdateHotlinks
commands.description: Re-reads the source files of hotlink module nodes and refreshes their cached content in the project, as the Hotlink Manager's Update button does.

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink nodes to update, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes. Each node's cached content is re-read from its source file, as the Hotlink Manager's Update button does.

commands.name: ChangeHotlinkNodes
commands.description: Repoints hotlink module nodes at other source files, as the Hotlink Manager's Relink button does. Follow it with UpdateHotlinks to re-read the content.

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink nodes to repoint at another source file, as the Hotlink Manager's Relink button does. The placed instances stay where they are. Follow it with UpdateHotlinks on the same nodes to re-read the content from the new file.

sourceLocation.description: Absolute path of the new module source file (.mod or .pln).

commands.name: GetHotlinkProxyElementTable
commands.description: Maps the proxy elements of placed hotlink instances to the elements of the source file they were made from, so an element seen in a hotlinked module can be traced back to its source element.

hotlinkInstances.description: The placed hotlink instances: elements of type Hotlink, for example the hotlinkId of an element inside one. Not the nodes GetHotlinks returns.

proxyElementTables.description: One item per requested instance, in order: its proxy elements with the source elements they were made from, or an error.

proxyElements.description: The proxy elements of the instance, in no particular order.

proxyElementId.description: The proxy element in the current project.

sourceElementId.description: The element in the hotlink's source file the proxy was made from.

commands.name: OpenProject
commands.description: Opens the given project.

projectFilePath.description: The target project file to open.

commands.name: NewProject
commands.description: Starts a new, untitled project from the template set in Archicad's New Project settings, as File > New does; with newAndReset also the working environment is reset, as New and Reset All does. The unsaved changes of the open project are discarded, as with OpenProject.

newAndReset.description: Optional. Also reset the working environment to the template's, as File > New > New and Reset All does, instead of keeping the current one as File > New does. Defaults to false.

commands.name: CloseProject
commands.description: Closes the currently opened project.

commands.name: SaveProject
commands.description: Saves the currently opened project.

projectPath.description: Optional. Full path of a .pln file to save the project to, as File > Save As does: the open project then refers to that file. This saves an untitled project, or one opened from an older Archicad version, which cannot be saved in place. An existing file at the path is overwritten. When omitted, or when it is the project's own file, the project is saved in place, which keeps the refusal of a project opened read-only.

commands.name: SaveAsModuleFile
commands.description: Saves the given elements, or the current selection, as a hotlink module (.mod) file.

moduleFilePath.description: Absolute path of the .mod file to write. An existing file is overwritten. The current window must be a floor plan, section, elevation or detail.

elements.description: Optional. The elements that go into the module; omitted, the current selection does, as Save Selection as Module would. Pass GetAllElements for the whole project. Archicad 25 and 26 support the selection form only.

commands.name: SaveProjectAsArchive
commands.description: Saves the open project as an archive (.pla) file, with the library parts it uses inside.

archiveFilePath.description: Absolute path of the .pla archive to write. An existing file is overwritten. The archive becomes the open project, as Save As does.

includeLibraryParts.description: Optional, true by default. Whether the library parts the project uses go into the archive, which makes the archive usable as a linked library of another project.

includeProperties.description: Optional, true by default. Whether the properties go into the archive.

includeTextures.description: Optional, false by default. Whether the linked textures go into the archive.

includeBackgroundPicture.description: Optional, false by default. Whether the background picture goes into the archive.

commands.name: SaveCurrentWindowAsImage
commands.description: Saves what the current window shows as an image file (png, jpg, bmp, tiff or gif), as File > Save as does with a picture format.

imageFilePath.description: Absolute path of the image file to write. An existing file is overwritten.

format.description: Optional. The image file format; omitted, it comes from the extension of imageFilePath (.png, .jpg or .jpeg, .bmp, .tif or .tiff, .gif).

colorDepth.description: Optional, trueColor by default. The color depth of the image, as in the Save as picture dialog.

dithered.description: Optional, false by default. Whether the image is dithered when its color depth drops colors.

entireDrawing.description: Optional, false by default. Whether the image covers the entire drawing of a 2D window instead of its current zoom, as the Entire Drawing option of the Save as picture dialog does.

imageFilePath.description: The path of the written image file.

zoom.description: The zoom of the window the image shows, as GetView2DTransformations reports it. Absent for the 3D window.

rotation.description: The orientation of the window in radian, as GetView2DTransformations reports it. Absent for the 3D window.

commands.name: GetCurrentViewImage
commands.description: Returns what the 3D window, or the PhotoRendering window, shows as a base64 encoded png or jpg image with its size in pixels, without writing a file. Available from Archicad 30.

source.description: Optional, 3DWindow by default. The window whose image is returned: the 3D window, or the PhotoRendering window.

format.description: Optional, png by default. The image format.

image.description: The base64 encoded image, in the requested format.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.
Number of decimals to display for area values.
Number of decimals to display for volume values.
Number of decimals to display for angle values.

preferenceTypes.description: The preference pages to get. Every page when missing.

outputScheme.description: The pages asked for, by name.

workingUnits.description: The Working Units page: the units and the number of decimals the model's lengths, areas, volumes and angles are shown with.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for area values.
Number of decimals to display for volume values.
Number of decimals to display for angle values.

dimensions.description: The Dimensions page: the dimension standard and the format (unit, decimals, extra accuracy and zero handling) of each dimension type.

dimensionStandardIndex.description: The index of the dimension standard the page follows.

linear.description: The format of the linear dimensions.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

showZeroWhole.description: Show the zero before the decimal point of values below one.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

parapet.description: The format of the sill height (parapet) dimensions.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

calculationUnits.description: The Calculation Units page: the units, the number of decimals and the extra accuracy of the values in element lists and schedules. GetCalculationUnits answers the same page.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.
Number of decimals to display for area values.
