WallModificationGeometryType.description: The wall's plan outline shape, distinct from its cross section shape.

WallProfileType.description: Cross section shape of the wall, distinct from geometryType (which is the plan outline).

WallModificationProfileType.description: Cross section shape of the wall, distinct from geometryType (which is the plan outline).

ClassificationSystemConflictPolicy.description: What to do with a system whose name already exists: merge, replace it, or keep the existing one.

ClassificationItemConflictPolicy.description: What to do with an item whose id already exists in a merged system: replace it or keep the existing one.

PropertyImportConflictPolicy.description: What to do with a property whose name already exists in its group: append imports it under a new unused name, replace replaces the existing definition, skip keeps the existing one.

DesignOptionLinkType.description: The type of the associated design option.

MEPDomainOrUnknown.description: The reported MEP domain. Unknown indicates that the domain could not be determined.

DrawingNameType.description: How the drawing's title name is assembled (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

DrawingNumberingType.description: How the drawing's title ID is assigned (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

MEPCrossSectionShape.description: Shape of an MEP routing segment's cross section.

MEPPreferenceTableDomain.description: The MEP domain of the segment preference tables.

TrimType.description: Which side of the trimming element the elements keep.

NavigatorItemType.description: The type of the navigator item.

LabelClass.description: Whether this is a textual or a symbol label.

TextBoxAnchor.description: Anchor point of the text box.

LabelLeaderLineAnchorPoint.description: How the leader line connects to the label text.

SymbolLabelTextDirection.description: Direction of the symbol label's text.

LengthType.description: The type of the length measurement unit.

AreaType.description: The type of the area measurement unit.

VolumeType.description: The type of the volume measurement unit.

AngleType.description: The type of the angle measurement unit.

IssueElementType.description: The attachment type of an element component of an issue.

IssueCommentStatus.description: The status of an issue comment.

AssociativeWitnessPoint.description: A witness point of a dimension. Give elementId (with line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus and nodeId as needed) for a point associated with an element, or only coordinate for a static point that is not associated with any element, like a point added by hand on empty space. A witness point takes either elementId or coordinate, not both.

coordinate.description: The position of a static (non-associative) witness point. Use it instead of elementId; the other fields are ignored for a static point.

name.description: The name of the translator, as the IFC Translators dialog shows it.

preview.description: Whether this is the preview translator, the one the IFC properties of elements are previewed with.

line.description: True when the witness point lies on an edge of the base element rather than at a node (API_Base line).

inIndex.description: Subindex of the base element's node (API_Neig inIndex).

special.description: Non-zero for special references such as a wall plane, a beam, window or door hole, or a mesh ridge (API_Base special).

nodeType.description: Reserved by Archicad for section dimensions (API_Base node_typ).

nodeStatus.description: Reserved by Archicad for section dimensions (API_Base node_status).

nodeId.description: Polygon vertex id of the base element, from its memo's vertexIDs, for elements with a polygon.

FavoritesFromElementUpdate.description: The identifier of the element and the name of the existing Favorite to update from it.

solidLinksWithTheGivenTarget.description: Links where the given element is the target (being cut or modified).

solidLinksWithTheGivenOperator.description: Links where the given element is the operator (performing the cut).

projectInfoName.description: Display name of the project info field.

projectInfoValue.description: Initial value of the project info field.

targetId.description: The element to be cut or modified.

ElementLinkReference.description: A directional link from one element to another.

fromElementId.description: The element the link starts from.

toElementId.description: The element the link points to.

ElementLinkData.description: A directional link from one element to another, with the flags stored on it.

fromElementId.description: The element the link starts from.

toElementId.description: The element the link points to.

flags.description: A 32-bit integer stored on the link, free for the script's own use (for example to tell apart the kinds of links it creates). Default is 0.

ElementLinksOrError.description: The links starting from an element, or an error.

links.description: The links starting from the element.

elementId.description: The element the link points to.

flags.description: The flags stored on the link by LinkElements.

nodeCoordinates.description: The corner points of the connected segment chain. Each consecutive pair of points becomes one segment, so a room with four walls needs five points to be closed, or four to be left open.

depth.description: How far each segment looks. Applied to every segment. Defaults to 1.0.

name.description: Name of the interior elevation. Each segment is named after it.

id.description: ID string of the interior elevation.

floorIndex.description: The story to place the interior elevation on. Defaults to the current story.

origin.description: If z is omitted, the instance's current z is kept.

rotationAngle.description: Rotation about the origin, counter-clockwise, in radians.

mirrored.description: Reflect the module's local X axis before the rotation.

layerIndex.description: Move the instance to this layer.

hotlinkNodeId.description: The node to place, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes. On Archicad 25 a node that has never been placed cannot be read, so a node created through the API can only be placed from Archicad 26 on.

origin.description: If z is omitted, the instance is placed at 0.

rotationAngle.description: Optional rotation about the origin, counter-clockwise, in radians. Defaults to 0.

mirrored.description: Optional. Reflects the module's local X axis before the rotation. Defaults to false.

floorIndex.description: Optional story the instance is placed on. Defaults to the current story.

floorDifference.description: Optional story offset applied to the module's stories. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer of the instance. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default layer.

skipNested.description: Optional. Do not place hotlinks nested inside the module. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

suspendFixAngle.description: Optional. Rotate fixed-angle elements with the module. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

ignoreTopFloorLinks.description: Optional. Top-linked elements keep their height rather than their top story link. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

relinkWallOpenings.description: Optional. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

adjustLevelDiffs.description: Optional. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

name.description: Library name.

path.description: A filesystem path to library location.

twServerUrl.description: URL address of the TeamWork server hosting the library.

urlWebLibrary.description: URL of the downloaded Internet library.

PropertyAvailabilityUpdate.description: Classification items the property is available for: set replaces the list, add and remove edit it.

id.description: The new code of the item, e.g. 21.10.

name.description: New name of the property.

groupId.description: Move the property into this custom property group.

defaultValue.description: New default value: a basic value or expressions. Switching between the two is allowed.

expressions.description: The new expression strings for the property. Only for expression-based properties.

possibleEnumValues.description: Values already on the property keep their identifier, so element values assigned to them survive; values not listed here are kept as well.

renameEnumValues.description: Change the text of existing enum options. The option keeps its identifier, so element values follow the new text.

removeEnumValues.description: Enum options to remove. Elements holding a removed option lose that value.

enumOrder.description: Every option's display text, once, in the new order (applied after rename, remove and add).

guid.description: The identifier of the enumeration value, as reported by GetAllProperties. An element's stored value refers to the value by this.

nonLocalizedValue.description: Nonlocalized value of the enumeration if there is one.

EnumValueToAdd.description: Text values for an enumeration option to add.

nonLocalizedValue.description: Nonlocalized value of the enumeration if there is one.

PropertyGroupId.description: The identifier of a property group.

PropertyGroupIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property group identifier.

PropertyIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property identifier.

isExpressionBased.description: True if the property value is computed from an expression.

expressions.description: The expression strings of an expression-based property. Only present when isExpressionBased is true.

defaultValueDisplay.description: The basic default value as text. Only for custom, non expression-based properties whose default is set.

availability.description: Classification items a custom property is available for.

defaultEnumValueIds.description: The option guids an enumeration property's default holds. Only for custom enumeration properties whose default is set.

PropertyValue.description: The display string value of a property.

PropertyValueArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property value.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property is available for the element. Only returned when includeAvailability is true.

PropertyValueErrorItem.description: An error in place of a property value.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property is available for the element. Only returned when includeAvailability is true.

PropertyValueOrErrorItem.description: A property value or an error

PropertyValuesArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property values.

PropertyValuesOrError.description: A list of property values or an error.

PropertyValuesOrErrorArray.description: A list of property value lists.

ElementPropertyValue.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner element.

ElementPropertyValues.description: A list of element property values.

AttributePropertyValue.description: A property value with the identifiers of the property and its owner attribute.

AttributePropertyValues.description: A list of attribute property values.

DisplayValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the displayed value.

NonLocalizedValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the nonlocalized value.

EnumValueId.description: The identifier of a property enumeration value.

EnumValueIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the identifier of a property enumeration value.

NormalOrUserUndefinedPropertyValue.description: A normal or a userUndefined property value.

PropertyValueDetails.description: A normal, userUndefined, notAvailable or notEvaluated property value.

UserUndefinedPropertyValue.description: A userUndefined value means that there is no actual number/string/etc. value, but the user deliberately set an Undefined value: this is a valid value, too.

NotAvailablePropertyValue.description: A notAvailable value means that the property is not available for the property owner (and therefore it has no property value for it).

NormalNumberPropertyValue.description: A number property value containing a valid numeric value.

NormalIntegerPropertyValue.description: An integer property value containing a valid integer number.

NormalStringPropertyValue.description: A string property value containing a valid string.

NormalBooleanPropertyValue.description: A boolean property value containing a valid boolean value.

NormalLengthPropertyValue.description: A length property value containing a real length value. The value is measured in SI (meters).

NormalAreaPropertyValue.description: An area property value containing a real area. The value is measured in SI (square meters).

NormalVolumePropertyValue.description: A volume property value containing a real volume. The value is measured in SI (cubic meters).

NormalAnglePropertyValue.description: An angle property value containing a real angle. The value is measured in SI (radians).

NormalNumberListPropertyValue.description: A number list property value containing numbers in an array.

NormalIntegerListPropertyValue.description: An integer list property value containing integers in an array.

NormalStringListPropertyValue.description: A string list property value containing strings in an array.

NormalBooleanListPropertyValue.description: A boolean list property value containing boolean values in an array.

NormalLengthListPropertyValue.description: A length list property value containing length values in an array. The values are measured in SI (meters).

NormalAreaListPropertyValue.description: An area list property value containing areas in an array. The values are measured in SI (square meters).

NormalVolumeListPropertyValue.description: A volume list property value containing volumes in an array. The values are measured in SI (cubic meters).

NormalAngleListPropertyValue.description: An angle list property value containing angles in an array. The values are measured in SI (radians).

NormalSingleEnumPropertyValue.description: A single enumeration property value containing the ID of the selected enum value.

MorphBody.description: A Morph's full body geometry: an indexed vertex list plus one entry per face (polygon). Shared shape between GetDetailsOfElements' output and CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs' input - what Get reports is what Create/Modify accept back. There is no fillet/chamfer operation in the Archicad API - a caller wanting rounded geometry must supply the already-tessellated facets here; edgeOverrides only controls how an existing straight edge is DISPLAYED (hidden/visible/smooth-shaded), not its shape.

bodyType.description: Whether the body is a closed solid or an open surface shell. Reported accurately on Get; on Create/Modify this is set on the element but a confirmed Archicad SDK bug means it may not take effect (bodyType has been observed always coming back Solid regardless of what was requested - see edgeOverrides' note).

isClosed.description: READ-ONLY, Get output only (ignored if sent to Create/Modify). Geometrically computed (Modeler::MeshBody::IsClosedBody): true if every edge in the body has exactly two adjacent faces (a watertight/manifold volume), false if any edge borders only one face (an open shell / has holes or gaps). Distinct from bodyType, which is the caller's declared INTENT (Solid vs Surface) rather than the actual computed geometry - a body can be declared bodyType 'Solid' yet still be geometrically open if a face is missing.

edgeDefault.description: Default display status for every edge that has no entry in edgeOverrides. Reported accurately on Get. On Create/Modify it takes effect from Archicad 29 on, where it is applied to every edge of the element with ACAPI_Element_ChangeMorphEdgeType right after the element is created or changed (e.g. 'HardHidden' hides all edges of a triangulated body). On Archicad 28 and earlier it is set on the element but does not take effect due to the same confirmed Archicad SDK bug as edgeOverrides (element.morph.edgeType is silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change).

vertices.description: Flat, indexed vertex list, local to the Morph's own placement (not world coordinates). A Solid body needs at least 4 (a tetrahedron, the minimum closed volume); a Surface body has no closedness requirement at all - the minimum is 2 vertices joined by a single wireEdge (a lone vertex with no edge at all is rejected by Archicad itself, confirmed live) - enforced with a bodyType-aware error message, not by this minItems floor alone.

polygons.description: One entry per face loop (into `vertices`), counterclockwise as seen from outside the body. Optional - a body made entirely of wireEdges (see below) needs none. Set "filled": false on an entry to create only that loop's edges (e.g. the outline of a pyramid's side faces) without an actual filled face.

wireEdges.description: Standalone edges that belong to no face at all (e.g. a bare rectangle outline, or a pyramid with a filled base but wireframe-only sides - set "filled": false on a polygons entry for a whole closed loop like that instead, this is for individual edges not already covered by any polygon loop). Reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (every edge with zero adjacent faces); accepted back by CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects - reuses whatever edge already exists between those two vertices if the polygons above happen to share it.

edgeOverrides.description: READ-ONLY in practice: reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (reflecting whatever Archicad itself currently has), but CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs silently ignore this field on input - per-edge display status cannot be set by an add-on due to a confirmed, still-unresolved Archicad SDK bug (element.morph.edgeType/bodyType are silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change; see the GRAPHISOFT community forum thread 'Help with setting morph's hidden edges in the API'). To hide or smooth ALL edges of a Morph use edgeDefault, which does take effect from Archicad 29 on. Sparse when present - only edges whose display status differs from edgeDefault get an entry. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects.

smooth.description: Shade the two adjacent faces smoothly across this edge instead of as a hard crease - the 'aide a la courbe' rounded-look hint. Does not change actual geometry.

silhouetteOnly.description: Show this edge's line only where it forms a silhouette/contour from the current viewpoint.

origin.description: Translation component of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's origin column).

xAxis.description: X axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's first column). Omit on Create to get an identity rotation; give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

yAxis.description: Y axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's second column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

zAxis.description: Z axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's third column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

buildingMaterialId.description: The Morph's building material - a single, whole-volume property (what the mass is 'made of', governing cut-fill/quantity takeoff), NOT settable per face. Per-face appearance is controlled separately by each polygon's own surfaceId (see MorphBody) - confirmed live these are two independent, unrelated attributes (a Morph can have one uniform building material while showing a different Surface finish on each face).

surfaceId.description: The Morph's own default Surface (element.morph.material) - used for any face that has no per-face surfaceId override of its own (see MorphBody polygons[].surfaceId). Distinct from buildingMaterialId (the whole-volume material). Confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this specific field when set through ACAPI_Element_Create alone (reproduced identically on Archicad 27 and 29 - not a version-specific issue, unlike polygons[].surfaceId below); CreateMorphs works around this transparently with an internal follow-up Change right after Create, so this field behaves correctly end-to-end despite the underlying quirk.

castShadow.description: Whether the body casts shadow in 3D.

receiveShadow.description: Whether the body receives shadow in 3D.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, the per-story visibility (showContour/showFill) is calculated automatically from the Morph's vertical extent instead of using the explicit values.

showContour.description: Which stories display this Morph's contour. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Create/Modify do not reliably apply it (showAllBelow/showRelAbove/showRelBelow silently come back reset even when explicitly set and isAutoOnStoryVisibility is false) - the same class of confirmed Archicad SDK write bug as bodyType/edgeType/level (see MorphBody's notes). Set on the element regardless since doing so is harmless and forward-compatible.

showFill.description: Which stories display this Morph's floor plan fill. Same write-reliability caveat as showContour.

cutFillPen.description: Overridden cut fill foreground pen (otherwise inherited from the building material). Omit to leave uninherited/unset.

cutFillBackgroundPen.description: Overridden cut fill background pen (otherwise inherited from the building material). Omit to leave uninherited/unset.

cutLineType.description: Line type of the cut contour.

overheadLineType.description: Line type of the overhead part (floor plan only).

overheadLinePen.description: Pen of the overhead part (floor plan only).

useCoverFillType.description: Use a dedicated floor plan fill instead of the one from the building material.

coverFillType.description: Floor plan fill type (only used when useCoverFillType is true).

use3DHatching.description: Derive the floor plan fill from the 3D material instead of coverFillType.

useDistortedCoverFill.description: Show the floor plan hatching as if projected onto a plane.

textureProjectionCoords.description: Texture projection coordinate system: origin, then 3 axis endpoints.

level.description: Z position of the free shape relative to the floor level. Reported accurately on Get, but a confirmed Archicad SDK bug means it may not take effect on Create/Modify (same class of bug as bodyType/edgeType - see MorphBody's notes).

pos.description: Position of the drawing's reference point on the layout.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.

ratio.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.

drawingScale.description: The nominal scale of the drawing.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing.

isCutWithFrame.description: Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon (see clipPolygon) instead of showing the full auto-fit extent.

bounds.description: Bounds of the drawing on the layout.

clipPolygon.description: Polygon (in model coordinates) used to clip the drawing view. Present only when isCutWithFrame is true.

navigatorItemId.description: The identifier of the navigator item (view/layout) this Drawing was created from. Read-only: Archicad only lets this be set at creation time (see CreateDrawings) - it cannot be changed afterwards to relink the Drawing to a different source.

customName.description: The drawing's custom title name. Present only when nameType is CustomName.

customNumber.description: The drawing's custom title ID. Present only when numberingType is CustomNumber.

isInNumbering.description: Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.

hasBorderLine.description: Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).

borderLineTypeIndex.description: Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.

borderPenIndex.description: Pen index of the drawing's border.

borderSize.description: Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.

titleLibraryPartIndex.description: Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.

titleElementId.description: Id of the drawing title, itself a placed GDL object element (font/pen/size aside, its own settings are reachable like any other element, e.g. with GetGDLParametersOfElements/SetGDLParametersOfElements). Absent if the drawing has no title object.

paragraphCount.description: Present only when labelClass is 'Text'. Read-only: number of paragraphs in the memo (Tapir's own Create/Modify commands always produce 1).

runs.description: Present only when labelClass is 'Text' and the content has paragraphs (always for content Tapir created): one entry per styled run, a single run too.

DimensionOrigin.description: The origin a level dimension measures from.

level.description: The level the dimension shows in meters: the height of the owner element at the position for an associative level dimension, the floor level or the static value otherwise.

staticLevel.description: The static flag as Archicad reports it. A level dimension created with a fixed 'level' and no parent keeps that value although Archicad reads this flag as false.

ownerElementId.description: Present only for an associative level dimension: the element it measures.

ownerElementType.description: Present only for an associative level dimension.

textHeight.description: Height of the dimension text in millimeters.

markerSize.description: Size of the marker in millimeters.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the marker in radians.

text.description: The text content. Newlines separate the lines.

position.description: The placement position of the text.

angle.description: The rotation angle in radians (same as style.angle).

height.description: The character height in millimeters (same as style.height).

pen.description: The pen attribute index (same as style.penIndex).

zCoordinate.description: The level of the text's floor.

style.description: The flat fields above are the subset SetDetailsOfElements takes back.

paragraphCount.description: Read-only: number of paragraphs in the memo (Tapir's own Create/Modify commands always produce 1).

runs.description: The styled runs of the content, present whenever the content has paragraphs (always for content Tapir created); one entry per run, a single run too, as a run may carry a pen, font, face or size of its own. Concatenating the runs' text in order gives the full content.

StairDetails.description: The settings of a Stair element, the ones CreateStairs takes. The finishes and the structure are modeled by the Stair's subelements (risers, treads and structures), which GetSubelementsOfHierarchicalElements lists.

level.description: Height of the stair base above the home story level.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute elevation of the stair base.

finishVisible.description: Whether the tread/riser finishes are modeled. If false only the stair structure (e.g. a monolith) is.

baseLinePoints.description: The baseline polyline the stair is placed along, as given to CreateStairs.

baseLineArcs.description: The curved segments of the baseline, present only when it has any.

TypeSpecificDetails.description: Represents the complete type-specific details of an element. Used as output from GET requests

ElementDetailsField.description: A field of the details of an element.

RevisionIssueId.description: The identifier of a revision issue.

DocumentRevisionId.description: The identifier of a document revision.

DocumentRevisionReference.description: A reference to a document revision belonging to the current issue

DocumentRevisionReferences.description: All document revisions belong to the current issue.

firstRevisionIssueId.description: The identifier of the first issue in which the given change is issued.

RoofPivotLine.description: A directed pivot line defined by its beginning and end coordinates. The roof plane rises on the left side of the line direction (begCoordinate towards endCoordinate); reverse the direction to tilt towards the other side.

name.description: The name of the design option.

id.description: The string id of the design option.

ownerSetName.description: The name of the owner design option set.

designOptionCombinationId.description: The guid identifier of the design option combination.

name.description: The name of the design option combination.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination. Available from Archicad 29.

name.description: The name of the design option combination.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination.

Zoom.description: A rectangular zoom box in model coordinates.

xMin.description: The minimum X value of the zoom box.

yMin.description: The minimum Y value of the zoom box.

xMax.description: The maximum X value of the zoom box.

yMax.description: The maximum Y value of the zoom box.

BoundingBox2D.description: A two-dimensional bounding box defined by its minimum and maximum coordinates.

RoofDetailsPivotLine.description: The pivot line about which a roof plane rotates.

eastings.description: Location along the easting of the coordinate system of the target map coordinate reference system.

northings.description: Location along the northing of the coordinate system of the target map coordinate reference system.

elevation.description: Orthogonal height relative to the vertical datum specified.

crsName.description: Name by which the coordinate reference system is identified.

description.description: Informal description of this coordinate reference system.

geodeticDatum.description: Name by which this datum is identified.

verticalDatum.description: Name by which the vertical datum is identified.

mapProjection.description: Name by which the map projection is identified.

mapZone.description: Name by which the map zone, relating to the MapProjection, is identified.

xAxisAbscissa.description: Value along the easting axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisAbscissa).

xAxisOrdinate.description: Value along the northing axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisOrdinate).

scale.description: Scale to be used, when the units of the CRS are not identical to the units of the engineering coordinate system (IfcMapConversion.Scale).

northings.description: Location along the northing of the coordinate system of the target map coordinate reference system.

xAxisAbscissa.description: Value along the easting axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisAbscissa).

xAxisOrdinate.description: Value along the northing axis of the end point of a vector indicating the position of the local x axis of the engineering coordinate reference system (IfcMapConversion.XAxisOrdinate).

scale.description: Scale to be used, when the units of the CRS are not identical to the units of the engineering coordinate system (IfcMapConversion.Scale).

positionInProject.description: The survey point's position in the project's coordinate system (Options > Project Preferences > Location Settings > Survey Point > Position). The map coordinates of the same point are in 'position'.

isVisible.description: Whether the survey point is shown in the project.

isLocked.description: Whether the survey point is locked, so it cannot be moved. Available from Archicad 26; left out on older versions.

positionInProject.description: The survey point's position in the project's coordinate system (Options > Project Preferences > Location Settings > Survey Point > Position). Moves the survey point in the project without changing its map coordinates in 'position'.

isVisible.description: Shows (true) or hides (false) the survey point. Omitted means unchanged.

isLocked.description: Locks (true) or unlocks (false) the survey point, so it cannot or can be moved. Omitted means unchanged. Available from Archicad 26; the command fails on older versions when it is given.

changes.description: All changes belonging to the given document revision.

RevisionChangesArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing an array of revision changes

StoryParameters.description: Represents all parameters of a single project story, including its unique identifiers. Used in API responses.

index.description: The story index.

dispOnSections.description: Story level lines should appear on sections and elevations.

height.description: Story height, calculated as the level of the story above minus this story's level. The topmost story gets its height from the virtual story that Archicad keeps above it in the story settings; only an Archicad that did not report that virtual story would leave the top story without a height.

name.description: The name of the story.

ifcId.description: The IFC GlobalId of the story, i.e. of the IfcBuildingStorey it is exported as (the same identifier the IFC Project Manager shows). Available from Archicad 28; older versions omit it.

StoriesParameters.description: A list of project stories, each with their complete parameters.

StorySettings.description: Contains the configurable settings for creating or modifying a story. Used as input in API requests.

index.description: The story index. Optional. The stories are matched to the existing ones positionally, from the bottom up. Giving the index of any of them pins the numbering of the whole list, so stories below the existing structure - basements with negative indices - can be requested as well. When given for more than one story, the indices must be consecutive.

dispOnSections.description: Story level lines should appear on sections and elevations.

name.description: The name of the story.

StoriesSettings.description: A list of story settings, used as input for creating or modifying multiple stories.

referencePosition.description: Reference point to automatically find zone.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the zone.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the zone.

ZoneCreationGeometry.description: Defines the geometry of a zone. Used as input for creating zones.

height.description: height relative to bottom

bottomOffset.description: base level of the wall relative to the floor level

offset.description: wall's base line's offset from ref. line

begThickness.description: Thickness at the beginning in case of trapezoid wall

endThickness.description: Thickness at the end in case of trapezoid wall

stampPosition.description: Position of the origin of the zone stamp.

stampAngle.description: Rotation angle of the zone stamp in radians.

fixedStampAngle.description: If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.

referencePosition.description: Moves the reference point of an automatic zone; the zone is found around the new point when zones are next updated. Ignored for a manual zone (isManual true).

ArcSettings.description: Settings for modifying an Arc or Circle. begAngle/endAngle are only applied to Arc, ignored for Circle.

SplineSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Spline. Only these settings fields are modifiable - Archicad's own API does not support changing Spline geometry (coordinates/closed) via ACAPI_Element_Change.

PolylineSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Polyline. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (single contour, no holes) and may change the number of vertices.

HatchSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Hatch. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (outline plus optional holes) and may change the number of vertices.

fillPenIndex.description: Setting a pen removes the foregroundColor override, so the pen shows.

fillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Setting a pen removes the backgroundColor override, so the pen shows.

foregroundColor.description: RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill foreground, used instead of fillPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillPenIndex when both are given.

backgroundColor.description: RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill background, used instead of fillBackgroundPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillBackgroundPenIndex when both are given.

DrawingSettings.description: Modifiable settings for a Drawing element placed on a layout.

pos.description: Position of the drawing's reference point on the layout.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.

ratio.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.

drawingScale.description: The nominal scale of the drawing.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing.

isCutWithFrame.description: Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon. Set to false to clear an existing crop and restore the drawing's full auto-fit extent. Only consulted when no clipPolygon is supplied in the same call - supplying a clipPolygon always enables clipping. Setting it to true without a clipPolygon merely re-enables the clip polygon already stored on the Drawing.

clipPolygon.description: Polygon (in model coordinates) used to clip the drawing view. At least 3 points. Setting this also enables polygon clipping (isCutWithFrame becomes true); to remove clipping, set isCutWithFrame to false instead.

customName.description: The drawing's custom title name. Only used when nameType is CustomName.

customNumber.description: The drawing's custom title ID. Only used when numberingType is CustomNumber.

isInNumbering.description: Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.

hasBorderLine.description: Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).

borderLineTypeIndex.description: Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.

borderPenIndex.description: Pen index of the drawing's border.

borderSize.description: Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.

titleLibraryPartIndex.description: Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.

TextSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Text element or a text-type Label. For Labels only the text field is applied. Setting text replaces the whole content (any per-run formatting of the old content is dropped) and switches the element to automatic width, matching the behavior of CreateTexts/CreateLabels.

text.description: The new text content. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF.

position.description: The placement position of the text. Only applied to Text elements.

angle.description: The rotation angle in radians. Only applied to Text elements.

height.description: The character height in millimeters. Only applied to Text elements. A multistyle Text takes its height from the per-run sizes of its content, so applying it rebuilds the content as one paragraph with the new height on every run (the runs' own pens/fonts/faces are kept) and switches the element to automatic width, as setting text does. Refused when the content holds an autotext run; give the new content explicitly via text then, or use ModifyTexts.

TypeSpecificSettings.description: Defines the modifiable type-specific settings for an element. Used as input for SET requests.

PropertyGroupArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a property group

PossibleEnumValues.description: The possible enum values of the property when the property type is enumeration.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the new property. Optional; when omitted, the default value is Undefined.

availability.description: The identifiers of classification items the new property is available for.

group.description: The property group defined by name or id. If both fields exists the id will be used.

EnumValuesToAdd.description: Enumeration values to add to a property.

PropertyDefinitionArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a property definition

items.description: The name of a favorite.

connectedElementId.description: The unique identifier of the connected element.

isExternal.description: True if the boundary is an external one.

neighbouringZoneElementId.description: Returns the unique identifier of the other Zone the element connects to if the boundary is internal. Please note that this boundary does not represent the boundary of the element with the other Zone.

area.description: The area of the polygon of the boundary.

polygonOutline.description: The outline polygon of the boundary.

ZoneBoundariesOrError.description: The response of the zone boundaries command or an error.

zoneBoundariesOfZones.description: The boundaries of each requested Zone, in the same order as the zones array of the input.

BuildingMaterialPhysicalPropertiesList.description: A list of building material physical properties

BuildingMaterialPhysicalProperties.description: The physical properties of a single building material.

ProjectInfoFields.description: A list of project info fields.

projectInfoId.description: The id of the project info field.

projectInfoName.description: The name of the project info field visible on UI.

projectInfoValue.description: The value of the project info field.

LibraryFileAdditions.description: A list of library file additions to the embedded library

inputPath.description: The path to the input file.

outputPath.description: The relative path to the new file inside embedded library.

LibraryPartType.description: Enumeration of available library part types. 'Unknown' is the schema-valid catch-all returned for any libpart whose typeID is not one of the named values (rare ACAPI sentinels and any future SDK subtype).

ElementsWithExecutionResults.description: The response of the GetElementsByType command.

ElementsWithExecutionResultsOrError.description: The response of the GetElementsByType command or an error.

FavoritesWrapper.description: The response of the GetFavoritesByType command.

FavoritesOrError.description: The response of the GetFavoritesByType command or an error.

ConnectedElementsWrapper.description: The response of the GetConnectedElements command.

ConnectedElementsOrError.description: The response of the GetConnectedElements command or an error.

ElementsOfDesignOptionOrError.description: The elements of the design option or an error.

index.description: Index of the attribute.

name.description: Name of the attribute.

modificationTime.description: The last modification time of the attribute, in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (a GSTime), the same stamp the Attribute Manager writes as ModiTime into its XML export.

AttributeCreationInfo.description: How, from where, by whom and when the attribute was created. Available from Archicad 30, and only for an attribute Archicad keeps a creation record of: legacy or imported attributes may have none, and then the field is left out. Any of the texts may be empty.

method.description: The creation method or workflow: AddOn (created by an Add-On), Merge (merging files), Paste (pasting from another file), New (created by the user through the UI), Import (an attribute file, IFC, DWG/DXF or another supported format), Explode (exploding a PDF or DWG), Duplicate (duplicating an attribute), Hotlink (a hotlinked file), XRef (a file attached in the Xref manager), Library (a library part), LibraryMaster (generated from GDL) or Unspecified.

methodDescription.description: Human-readable description of the creation method.

source.description: Human-readable origin, for example the name of the file or Add-On the attribute came from.

creatorUserName.description: The Teamwork user name, or the OS login name in a solo project, at the time of creation.

creationTime.description: The creation time of the attribute, in seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (a GSTime), the same scale as modificationTime.

AttributeHeadersWrapper.description: The response of the GetAttributesByType command.

AttributeHeadersOrError.description: The response of the GetAttributesByType command or an error.

GroupIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the group identifier.

ElementsWrapper.description: A list of elements wrapped in an object.

ElementsWrapperOrError.description: A list of elements or an error.

ElementOrGroupId.description: An identifier representing either an Element or a Group.

ElementOrGroupIds.description: A list of element and/or group identifiers.

ElementGroupParameters.description: The parameters for creating a single group

elements.description: The elements or child groups to be grouped.

parentGroupId.description: Optional parent group ID to nest this group under.

DimensionData.description: Dimension element data including witness points and geometry.

witnessPoints.description: The witness points of the dimension. Besides the geometry each item carries the base element reference as CreateAssociativeDimensions takes it (API_Base: baseElementId, line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus, nodeId): read a dimension placed by hand to learn the values an element type needs.

DesignOptionCombinationId.description: The identifier of a design option combination.

name.description: The name of the design option.

id.description: The string id of the design option.

ownerSetName.description: The name of the owner design option set.

SolidOperationType.description: The type of solid element operation.

SolidLinkFlags.description: Flags controlling the behaviour of a solid element operation link.

inheritOperatorAttributes.description: If true, the target element inherits the attributes of the operator element.

skipPolygonHoles.description: If true, holes of the operator (roof/slab) are ignored during the operation.

SpecialFolderType.description: The type of a special folder of the running Archicad.

path.description: The path of the special folder in the filesystem.

SpecialFolderPathOrError.description: The path of a special folder or an error.

SpecialFolderPathsOrErrors.description: A list of special folder paths or errors.

ConnectionItem.description: An element connected with its beginning or end point.

connectedWithBeginPoint.description: True if the element is connected with its beginning point, false if it is connected with its end point.

EndpointConnections.description: The connections of a wall, beam or beam segment.

connectedToBeginPoint.description: Elements connected to the beginning point of the element.

connectedToEndPoint.description: Elements connected to the end point of the element.

connectedWithReferenceLineToEndPoints.description: Elements connected with their reference line to the beginning or end point of the element.

connectedToReferenceLine.description: Elements connected to the reference line of the element, not at its endpoints.

crossingReferenceLine.description: Elements whose reference line intersects the reference line of the element.

ZoneBoundaryPart.description: Section of a wall, beam or curtain wall segment related to a zone.

roomEdgeIndex.description: Index of the zone polygon edge adjacent to the element (not present for beams).

begDistance.description: Beginning distance of the section from the beginning point of the element.

endDistance.description: End distance of the section from the beginning point of the element.

ZoneRelations.description: The relations of a zone: the related elements grouped by type and the boundary sections of walls, beams and curtain wall segments.

elementsGroupedByType.description: The elements related to the zone, grouped by element type.

wallParts.description: Sections of walls that border the zone.

beamParts.description: Sections of beams related to the zone.

curtainWallSegmentParts.description: Sections of curtain wall segments that border the zone.

ElementRelationsOrError.description: The type-specific relations of an element or an error. The variant depends on the type of the input element.

CoverFill.description: Floor plan cover fill settings of a Column or Beam.

use.description: Whether the cover fill is shown on the floor plan.

useFromSurface.description: Whether the fill is taken from the top surface material of the element.

orientationComesFrom3D.description: Whether the cover fill orientation comes from the 3D view of the element.

CoverFillTransformation.description: Orientation and distortion parameters of a cover fill.

origin.description: The origin of the fill relative to the center of the element.

FloorFill.description: Floor plan cover fill settings of a Slab. When modifying an element, omitted properties keep their current values.

use.description: Whether the cover fill is shown on the floor plan.

use3DHatching.description: Use Vectorial 3D Hatch patterns in Floor Plan view, taken from the top side material.

HatchOrientation.description: Orientation and distortion parameters of a fill. When modifying an element, omitted properties keep their current values.

origin.description: The origin of the fill relative to the project origin.

matrix00.description: X component of the primary distortion (direction) vector.

matrix10.description: Y component of the primary distortion (direction) vector.

matrix01.description: X component of the secondary distortion vector.

matrix11.description: Y component of the secondary distortion vector.

innerRadius.description: Radius for circular fill distortion, used when type is Centered.

OverriddenMaterial.description: A surface material that may override the one inherited from the element's structure (building material, composite or profile).

overridden.description: True if the material is overridden on the element level.

OverriddenPen.description: A pen index that may override the one inherited from the element's structure. On Archicad versions where the underlying element does not support this override, 'overridden' is always false.

overridden.description: True if the pen is overridden on the element level.

TextRunDetails.description: One monostyle run of text (API_RunType). Concatenating 'text' across all runs in order gives the full content; a newline character starts a new line.

text.description: The run's text content. Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF.

penIndex.description: Pen attribute index. Optional; defaults to the style's penIndex.

fontIndex.description: Font attribute index. Optional; defaults to the style's fontIndex.

fontName.description: Name of the font for this run only, resolved like the style's fontName (and taking precedence over the run's fontIndex). Optional; defaults to the style's font. Read back as the name of the font the run's fontIndex refers to, absent when no loaded font has that index.

heightOverride.description: Character height in mm for this run only. Optional; defaults to the style's height.

effectStrikeout.description: Optional; defaults to the style's effectStrikeout.

effectSuperscript.description: Optional; defaults to the style's effectSuperscript.

effectSubscript.description: Optional; defaults to the style's effectSubscript.

effectProtected.description: Optional; defaults to the style's effectProtected.

TextStyleSettableDetails.description: Every user-configurable style setting of a Text or a text-class Label (API_TextType). Shared by CreateTexts/CreateLabels ('style'), ModifyTexts/ModifyLabels ('style'), and the Get response.

fontName.description: Name of the font, as the Font attributes carry it and GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, e.g. 'Arial'. Resolved to the font's index (exact match first, then case-insensitive); the command fails when no loaded font has the name. Takes precedence over fontIndex if both are given.

height.description: Character height in mm.

angle.description: Rotation angle in radians.

widthFactor.description: Width scale of the text, between 0.75 and 10.0.

fixedSize.description: Size does not depend on output scale.

usedContour.description: Draw the frame of the text block.

usedFill.description: Draw a solid fill behind the text block.

contourPenIndex.description: Pen index of the text block's frame.

fillPenIndex.description: Pen index of the text block's background fill.

fixedAngle.description: The rotation angle does not change when the element is rotated.

contourOffset.description: Offset of the frame/background fill from the text bounding box, in mm.

flipEnabled.description: The text should always be readable (flips when viewed upside down).

textFrameShape.description: Text frame shape. Standalone Text elements only support Rectangle. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as Rectangle.

GraphicOverrideElementType.description: The tool an element was created with. Limited to tools that are not backed by a built-in GDL library part (Door, Window, Object, Lamp, Zone, Label, Grid and most MEP part types are intentionally excluded - their identification relies on a library part guid that was confirmed to differ across ArchiCAD builds, so it cannot be hardcoded reliably).

GraphicOverrideCriterion.description: Structured conditions of a graphic override rule, turned into Archicad's criterion XML (an alternative to criterionXML). Give exactly one property. 'and'/'or' combine a flat list of other conditions (no nesting, see their description). 'elementType' filters by the tool an element was created with; 'all3DTypes'/'all2DTypes' match every 3D or 2D element. The other properties are conditions of Archicad's criteria editor: classification, layer and Model View, Construction, Positioning, Plan and Section, Surfaces and Materials, ID and Categories, Geometry, custom properties, and fields of the Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Object/Lamp, Door/Window, Opening, Curtain Wall and Stair tools. Their identifiers were captured from rules made in the criteria editor of Archicad 29; Archicad 27 keeps the generated rules as well. Not available: the renovation status of an element, and the shape, limits and orientation of an Opening.

and.description: Matches if all of the nested criteria match. The nested criteria must all be leaves (elementType, classification, layer*, ...) - an 'and'/'or' nested inside this array is rejected, ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not reliably support that depth of nesting.

or.description: Matches if any of the nested criteria match. The nested criteria must all be leaves (elementType, classification, layer*, ...) - an 'and'/'or' nested inside this array is rejected, ArchiCAD's criteria editor does not reliably support that depth of nesting.

roofLevelNumber.description: Matches roofs whose level number equals this value.

roofEaveOverhangType.description: Matches roofs whose eave overhang type equals this.

roofPitch.description: Matches roofs that have a pitch equal to this value (degrees) among their panels.

shellCutBodyType.description: Matches shells whose cut body type equals this.

shellTiltAngle.description: Matches shells whose tilt angle equals this value (degrees).

shellGeometryType.description: Matches shells whose geometry type equals this.

hatchFill.description: Matches elements whose hatch is this Fill attribute (by name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.

hatchFillNot.description: Matches elements whose hatch is NOT this Fill attribute (by name).

lineAttribute.description: Matches elements whose contour/line is this Line Type attribute (by name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.

lineAttributeNot.description: Matches elements whose contour/line is NOT this Line Type attribute (by name).

fontIs.description: Matches elements whose font equals this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western') exactly. Applies to 2D annotation (Text/Label) elements - unlike every other field in this schema, this one and 'textPen*' are NOT combined with a 3D-model-element anchor when used alone or together, since they don't apply to 3D model elements.

fontContains.description: Matches elements whose font is one of a list containing this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western') (ArchiCAD's 'contains' operator for a font field).

fontNotContains.description: Matches elements whose font is not one of a list containing this font name (as GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, with its script, e.g. 'Arial Western').

penReplacement.description: Matches elements whose pen replacement rule equals this value.

penReplacementNot.description: Matches elements whose pen replacement rule does not equal this value.

linePenContains.description: Matches elements whose line pen number is this value (by plain pen number 1-255, not an attribute name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.

linePenNotContains.description: Matches elements whose line pen number is NOT this value (by plain pen number 1-255).

textPenIs.description: Matches elements whose text pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255). Applies to 2D annotation elements - see 'fontIs' for the anchor-exemption note.

textPenContains.description: Matches elements whose text pen number is this value (ArchiCAD's 'contains' operator for a pen field, by plain pen number 1-255).

textPenNotContains.description: Matches elements whose text pen number is NOT this value (by plain pen number 1-255).

hatchContourPen.description: Matches elements whose hatch contour pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255). Unlike 'linePenContains', ArchiCAD offers strict is/is-not here, not contains/does-not-contain.

hatchContourPenNot.description: Matches elements whose hatch contour pen number does not equal this value (by plain pen number 1-255).

openingEndSurface.description: Matches Opening elements whose end surface equals this Surface attribute (by name).

openingEndSurfaceNot.description: Matches Opening elements whose end surface does not equal this Surface attribute (by name).

openingExtrusionSurface.description: Matches Opening elements whose extrusion surface equals this Surface attribute (by name).

openingExtrusionSurfaceNot.description: Matches Opening elements whose extrusion surface does not equal this Surface attribute (by name).

curtainWallPanelCutLinePen.description: Matches Curtain Wall elements whose panel cut line pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255).

curtainWallPanelCutLinePenNot.description: Matches Curtain Wall elements whose panel cut line pen number does not equal this value.

constructionMaterialNot.description: Matches elements NOT built with this Building Material attribute (by name).

surface.description: Matches elements whose surface is this Surface (Material) attribute (by name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.

surfaceNot.description: Matches elements whose surface is NOT this Surface (Material) attribute (by name).

variantSetIsNot.description: Matches elements whose Variant Set does not equal this string. Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.

profileParameter.description: Matches elements by a custom Complex Profile modifier parameter, identified by its plain name as defined on that Complex Profile attribute (e.g. 'Debord tole') rather than a fixed field - use this for any profile modifier not covered by the profileStretchHeight/profileNominalWidth/... fields above. Provide 'name' and exactly one comparison operator.

name.description: The profile modifier parameter's name, exactly as defined on the Complex Profile attribute.

customPropertyBool.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) boolean property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under (both exactly as shown in the Property Manager). Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one of the operators below. The 6 'has.../is...' operators are available on every custom property type, not just boolean ones.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined (e.g. 'Generalites').

equals.description: Matches if the property's value equals this.

hasDefaultValue.description: If true, matches elements where this property currently has its default value.

hasCustomValue.description: If true, matches elements where this property has a custom (overridden, non-default) value.

isAvailable.description: If true, matches elements where this property is available.

isNotAvailable.description: If true, matches elements where this property is not available.

isUndefined.description: If true, matches elements where this property is undefined.

isNotUndefined.description: If true, matches elements where this property is not undefined.

customPropertyString.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) text or option-set property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

equals.description: Matches if the property's value equals this string exactly.

notEquals.description: Matches if the property's value does not equal this string.

customPropertyNumber.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) numeric property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

customPropertyInteger.description: Matches elements by a custom (user-defined) integer property, identified by its plain name and the name of the property group it appears under. Provide 'name', 'group', and exactly one operator.

name.description: The custom property's name, exactly as defined.

group.description: The custom property group's name, exactly as defined.

GraphicOverrideCombinationIdOrError.description: A graphic override combination identifier or an error.

GraphicOverrideFillTypes.description: The fill types an override applies to.

GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes.description: The surface types an override applies to.

GraphicOverrideStyle.description: What a graphic override rule overrides and how. A field that is left out is not overridden.

lineType.description: The line type that replaces the line type of lines.

lineMarkerTextPen.description: The pen index that replaces the pen of lines, markers and texts.

fillType.description: The fill type that replaces the fill type of fills.

fillTypeAppliesTo.description: The fills the fill type override applies to. Left out: all fills.

fillForegroundPen.description: The pen index that replaces the foreground pen of fills.

fillForegroundPenAppliesTo.description: The fills the foreground pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.

fillBackgroundPen.description: The pen index that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundColor.

fillBackgroundColor.description: The color that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundPen.

fillBackgroundPenAppliesTo.description: The fills the background pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.

surface.description: The surface that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surfaceColor.

surfaceColor.description: The color that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surface.

surfaceAppliesTo.description: The surfaces the surface override applies to. Left out: all surfaces.

overridePenColorAndThickness.description: Override the pen color and thickness.

hiddenContours.description: The contours to hide when overrideContours is true.

GraphicOverrideRule.description: A graphic override rule with its rule group, criterion and style.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group the rule belongs to.

criterionXML.description: The criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Change its values and pass it to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules to make similar rules.

GraphicOverrideRuleOrError.description: A graphic override rule or an error.
